questions.q: Under the National Commission for Homoeopathy Act, 2020, the National Register of homoeopathic practitioners is maintained by the:
opts: Medical Assessment and Rating Board for Homoeopathy
Board of Ethics and Registration for Homoeopathy
Central Council for Research in Homoeopathy
questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. The NCH Act 2020 replaced the HCC Act 1973 and set up three autonomous boards.

questions.q: How many succussions are given at each step of the LM (50 millesimal) potency?
questions.why: The 6th edition prescribes 100 strong succussions for each LM step. The 5th edition used 2 for centesimal potencies.

questions.q: Under the current UIP, fractional IPV (fIPV, 0.1 mL intradermal) is given at:
questions.why: Since 2023 a third fIPV dose at 9 months has been added to the 6- and 14-week doses.

questions.q: On a standard ECG recorded at 25 mm/s, the R–R interval is 4 large squares. The heart rate is about:
questions.why: Each large square is 0.2 s; heart rate = 300 ÷ number of large squares = 300 ÷ 4 = 75/min.

questions.q: Jaundice persisting beyond two weeks in an infant with pale clay-coloured stools and dark urine most suggests:
questions.why: Conjugated hyperbilirubinaemia with acholic stools points to biliary atresia, which needs surgery (Kasai) before 8 weeks.

questions.q: According to Kent, if the first prescription has produced no action at all, the next prescription is:
opts: always a repetition of the same remedy in a higher potency
not a second prescription, but really a first prescription again
questions.why: Kent: the second prescription is the one that follows a prescription that has acted; if the first did nothing, the next is still a first prescription.

questions.q: A patient says she always feels guilty, as if she had committed some crime. The most suitable Kent rubric is:
opts: Mind, Delusions, persecuted, that he is
Mind, Anxiety, conscience, of (as if guilty of a crime)
questions.why: Kent's rubric 'Anxiety of conscience, as if guilty of a crime' converts this expression exactly.
Lientery is the passing of food undigested in the stool.

questions.q: Radical cure of Plasmodium vivax malaria under the Indian national programme requires, after G6PD consideration:
questions.why: Primaquine (0.25 mg/kg daily for 14 days) kills the liver hypnozoites that cause relapse; chloroquine treats only the blood stage.

questions.q: The investigation of choice for acute subarachnoid haemorrhage is (GPSC Medical Officer, 2025):
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Lumbar puncture for xanthochromia only if CT is negative.
